---
title: "Most draft-eligible college seasons end without an NFL outcome"
date: "2026-10-24"
description: "Only 3.6% of draft-eligible college player-seasons end in a draft selection and 8.3% in NFL entry, more entrants arrive undrafted than drafted, the per-season entry chance rises from 4.1% to 20.4% by the fourth eligible season, and the drafted share fell from 5.9% (2012 class) to 2.6% (2025)."
followups:
  - "Evaluate out-of-time models with calibration metrics, since the positive class is rarer in later draft classes than in training data."
  - "Include the eligible-season index as a model term; the entry hazard varies fourfold across it."
  - "Treat made-roster and rookie-games as a separate second-stage prediction problem, not a footnote on entry."
author:
  - "An AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto

```{r}
#| label: setup
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# Wilson interval for a binomial proportion.
wilson <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- x / n
  d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  c <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d
  h <- (z / d) * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))
  c(lo = pmax(0, c - h), hi = pmin(1, c + h))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load
# The connection message is an implementation detail; the reader sees only
# the counts in the visible chunk below.
outcomes <- tbl(con, "outcomes") |> collect()
dbDisconnect(con)

risk <- outcomes |>
  filter(draft_eligible, outcome_observed_d) |>
  mutate(
    outcome_signed_udfa_d = coalesce(outcome_signed_udfa_d, FALSE),
    outcome_drafted_d = coalesce(outcome_drafted_d, FALSE),
    outcome_nfl_entry_d = coalesce(outcome_nfl_entry_d, FALSE)
  )

n_risk <- nrow(risk)
n_players <- n_distinct(risk$playerId)
# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are administratively right-censored and carry
no outcomes, so they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted
as failures.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

- A model that forecasts who reaches the NFL has to beat the trivial forecast
  that nobody does, which is right for
  `r pct(1 - mean(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d))` of draft-eligible college
  seasons.
- This post measures that base rate and its parts: how often each outcome
  occurs, which route into the league is larger, how the chance changes over
  a player's eligible seasons and across draft classes, and how often the
  players who arrive actually play, with five quarterbacks from earlier posts
  (Joe Burrow, Cam Ward, Jordan Travis, Shane Buechele, Kyle Allen) as
  running examples.

## 2. Data

### Every eligible season ends in exactly one of five statuses

A **player-season** is one player's college season with a recorded stat
line, it is **eligible** when the following draft comes at least three years
after his high-school graduation (so a freshman season never counts), and
the table defines the five ways an eligible season can end.

```{r}
#| label: status-terms
status_terms <- tribble(
  ~Status                             , ~`NFL entry` , ~Definition                                                                                                                                                                         ,
  "Drafted"                           , "Yes"        , "Selected in the NFL draft held the spring after the season, reported by round: round 1, rounds 2 to 3, rounds 4 to 7."                                                         ,
  "Signed as an undrafted free agent" , "Yes"        , "Not selected in that draft, but on an NFL roster within the entry window afterward (matched by a guarded name lookup)."                                                         ,
  "Still playing next season"         , "No"         , "Back on a college roster the next season; the season is one more turn of the eligibility clock, not an outcome."                                                                ,
  "Exhausted eligibility undrafted"   , "No"         , "The player's last observed college season, with no draft selection and no NFL roster appearance after it."                                                                      ,
  "Left the data early"               , "No"         , "Absent the next season although his record says a next season should exist (a transfer with sitting time, an injury retirement, or an unobserved departure); the outcome is unknown."
)
kable(
  status_terms,
  caption = "The five end-of-season statuses. NFL entry means drafted or signed as an undrafted free agent."
)
```

### The risk set counts seasons, while each NFL event falls on one season per player

A player usually contributes several eligible seasons, so the risk set below
is larger in seasons than in players, and the pin after it confirms that no
player carries more than one NFL event.

```{r}
#| label: risk-set
risk_set <- tibble(
  Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"),
  Count = format(c(n_risk, n_players), big.mark = ",")
)
kable(risk_set, caption = "The risk set: eligible seasons with an observed outcome.")
```

```{r}
#| label: grain-pin
# The draft and UDFA events are mutually exclusive, their union is the entry
# label on every row, and no player enters twice. A violation here would
# poison every rate below (a naive mean(na.rm = TRUE) over a partially NA flag
# once read UDFA prevalence at 35 percent instead of 4.7).
stopifnot(
  !any(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d),
  all(
    risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d ==
      (risk$outcome_drafted_d | risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
  ),
  !anyDuplicated(risk$playerId[risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d]),
  n_risk == 68993,
  n_players == 36223
)
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Fewer than four in every hundred eligible seasons end in a draft selection

```{r}
#| label: ledger-nums
#| include: false
p_drafted <- mean(risk$outcome_drafted_d)
p_udfa <- mean(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
p_entry <- mean(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d)
n_drafted <- sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d)
n_udfa <- sum(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
n_entry <- sum(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d)
ci_drafted <- wilson(n_drafted, n_risk)
```

*Expectation: the draft is rare, under five percent of eligible seasons.* ✅

Out of every 100 eligible seasons, `r fmt(100 * p_drafted, 1)` end drafted
and `r fmt(100 * p_entry, 1)` in NFL entry by either route, and the ledger
lists each outcome with its 95 percent confidence interval, the range the
true rate plausibly occupies given how many seasons were observed (computed
by Wilson's method, which behaves well for rare events).

```{r}
#| label: ledger
ledger <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Outcome = c(
      "Drafted, any round",
      "  Drafted, round 1",
      "  Drafted, rounds 2 to 3",
      "  Drafted, rounds 4 to 7",
      "Signed as an undrafted free agent",
      "NFL entry (drafted or UDFA)"
    ),
    n_event = c(
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d),
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d == 1L),
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3),
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d >= 4L),
      sum(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d),
      sum(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d)
    )
  )
) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  transmute(
    Outcome,
    Events = format(n_event, big.mark = ","),
    `At risk` = format(n_risk, big.mark = ","),
    Prevalence = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_event / n_risk),
    `95% CI` = sprintf(
      "[%.1f%%, %.1f%%]",
      100 * wilson(n_event, n_risk)["lo"],
      100 * wilson(n_event, n_risk)["hi"]
    )
  )

kable(
  ledger,
  caption = "How often each outcome occurs among eligible player-seasons."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: ledger-pin
stopifnot(
  p_drafted < 0.04,
  ci_drafted["hi"] < 0.05,
  n_drafted == 2479,
  n_udfa == 3239
)
```

### 3.2 More NFL entrants arrive undrafted than drafted

```{r}
#| label: routes
#| include: false
routes <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    route = case_when(
      !outcome_drafted_d ~ "Undrafted free agent",
      outcome_draft_round_d == 1L ~ "Drafted, round 1",
      outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3 ~ "Drafted, rounds 2 to 3",
      TRUE ~ "Drafted, rounds 4 to 7"
    )
  ) |>
  count(route, name = "n") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), route = reorder(route, share))
udfa_share <- n_udfa / n_entry
```

*Expectation: undrafted free-agent entry rivals the draft as an NFL route.* ✅

Splitting the `r fmt(n_entry)` NFL entries by route, each bar a share of all
entrants with its count in the label, shows the undrafted route alone carries
`r pct(udfa_share)` of them, more than all seven rounds of the draft
combined.

```{r}
#| label: routes-fig
#| fig-height: 5
p_routes <- ggplot(routes, aes(x = 100 * share, y = route)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s entrants (%.1f%%)", route, fmt(n), 100 * share),
      data_id = route
    ),
    width = 0.7,
    fill = "#1B9E77"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", 100 * share, fmt(n))),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 45,
    y = 2.2,
    label = sprintf(
      "More than half of all entrants\nnever hear their name called:\n%s of %s",
      fmt(n_udfa),
      fmt(n_entry)
    ),
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 60,
    y = 2.6,
    xend = 55,
    yend = 3.62,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 85) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "The undrafted route is the largest way into the NFL",
    subtitle = "Share of NFL entrants by entry route, all eligible seasons",
    x = "Share of NFL entrants",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Each bar is the route's percent of all entrants; the label lists the count behind it."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_routes, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5)
```

The five running examples cover both routes, and the table reads each one's
entry season straight from the data.

```{r}
#| label: examples
cast <- c(
  "Joe Burrow",
  "Cameron Ward",
  "Jordan Travis",
  "Shane Buechele",
  "Kyle Allen"
)
examples <- risk |>
  filter(player %in% cast, outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    Route = if_else(
      outcome_drafted_d,
      sprintf(
        "Drafted, round %d, pick %d",
        outcome_draft_round_d,
        outcome_draft_pick_d
      ),
      "Undrafted free agent"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(draft_year) |>
  select(
    Player = player,
    `Final college season` = season,
    `Draft class` = draft_year,

  )
kable(
  examples,
  caption = "The running examples at their NFL entry. Eligible season counts the player's draft-eligible college seasons from one."
)
```

```{r}

stopifnot(
  udfa_share > 0.5,
  nrow(examples) == 5,
  ex("Joe Burrow", "Draft class") == 2020,
  ex("Joe Burrow", "Route") == "Drafted, round 1, pick 1",
  ex("Joe Burrow", "Eligible season") == 3,
  ex("Cameron Ward", "Draft class") == 2025,
  ex("Cameron Ward", "Route") == "Drafted, round 1, pick 1",
  ex("Cameron Ward", "Eligible season") == 3,
  ex("Jordan Travis", "Draft class") == 2024,
  ex("Jordan Travis", "Route") == "Drafted, round 5, pick 171",
  ex("Jordan Travis", "Eligible season") == 4,
  ex("Shane Buechele", "Draft class") == 2021,
  ex("Shane Buechele", "Route") == "Undrafted free agent",
  ex("Kyle Allen", "Draft class") == 2018,
  ex("Kyle Allen", "Route") == "Undrafted free agent"
```

### 3.3 Most eligible seasons end with the player coming back, not with an outcome

```{r}
#| label: status
#| include: false
status_tab <- risk |>
  count(status_end_of_season, name = "seasons") |>
  mutate(
    share = seasons / sum(seasons),
    # Reader-facing labels for the statuses defined in Section 2.
    status_label = dplyr::recode(
      status_end_of_season,
      "continuing" = "Still playing next season",
      "exhausted_undrafted" = "Exhausted eligibility undrafted",
      "left_data" = "Left the data early",
      "signed_udfa" = "Signed as an undrafted free agent",
      "drafted" = "Drafted"
    ),
    status_label = reorder(status_label, share)
  )
st <- function(s) status_tab$share[status_tab$status_end_of_season == s]
```

*Expectation: exhausted eligibility is the most common end-of-season status.*
❌

The share of eligible seasons ending in each status shows NFL outcomes fill
only the two shortest bars, because `r pct(st("continuing"))` of eligible
seasons are mid-career and end with the player simply returning, ahead of
the `r pct(st("exhausted_undrafted"))` that end with eligibility exhausted.

```{r}

  ) +

```

```{r}
#| label: status-pin
stopifnot(
  abs(sum(status_tab$share) - 1) < 1e-8,
  st("continuing") > 0.45,
  st("exhausted_undrafted") > 0.3,
  st("continuing") > st("exhausted_undrafted"),
  st("left_data") > 0.05,
  abs(st("drafted") + st("signed_udfa") - p_entry) < 1e-8
)
```

### 3.4 The chance of entry rises with each eligible season a player waits

```{r}
#| label: hazard
#| include: false
hazard <- risk |>
  group_by(eligible_season_index) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    across(
      c(outcome_drafted_d, outcome_signed_udfa_d, outcome_nfl_entry_d),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(seasons >= 100)

hazard_long <- hazard |>
  select(
    eligible_season_index,
    seasons,
    Drafted = outcome_drafted_d,
    `Undrafted free agent` = outcome_signed_udfa_d,
    `NFL entry` = outcome_nfl_entry_d
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(eligible_season_index, seasons),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "p"
  )
hz <- function(k, col = "outcome_nfl_entry_d") {
  hazard[[col]][hazard$eligible_season_index == k]
}
```

*Expectation: the chance of NFL entry rises over a player's eligible
seasons.* ✅

Because most seasons are mid-career, the figure tracks the **hazard**, the
share of players still unentered and still playing at their first, second,
third eligible season (and so on) whose very next draft is the one that
takes them, which rises from `r pct(hz(1))` in the first eligible season to
`r pct(hz(4))` in the fourth.

```{r}
#| label: hazard-fig
#| fig-height: 6
hz_tip <- function(k, outcome, p, n) {
  sprintf("Eligible season %d, %s: %.1f%% of %s seasons", k, outcome, 100 * p, fmt(n))
}
p_hazard <- ggplot(
  filter(hazard_long, outcome != "NFL entry"),
  aes(eligible_season_index, p, color = outcome)
) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(hazard_long, outcome == "NFL entry"),
    aes(eligible_season_index, p),
    linewidth = 1.4,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray35"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = hz_tip(eligible_season_index, outcome, p, seasons)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = filter(hazard_long, outcome == "NFL entry"),
    aes(
      eligible_season_index,
      p,
      tooltip = hz_tip(eligible_season_index, outcome, p, seasons)
    ),
    size = 3,
    color = "gray35"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2.2,
    y = 0.225,
    label = sprintf(
      "NFL entry (dashed) peaks in the\nfourth eligible season at %.1f%%",
      100 * hz(4)
    ),
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 3.75,
    y = 0.225,
    xend = 3.95,
    yend = 0.209,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.6,
    y = 0.01,
    label = "Burrow and Ward drafted in their third eligible season,\nTravis in his fourth",
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 3,
    y = 0.022,
    xend = 3,
    yend = 0.051,
    curvature = 0,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 3.85,
    y = 0.016,
    xend = 3.97,
    yend = 0.038,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x),
    limits = c(0, 0.25)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = hazard$eligible_season_index) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Waiting raises the chance of entry, mostly through undrafted signings",
    subtitle = "Per-season chance of each outcome by eligible season",
    x = "Eligible season (1 = first season the player could be drafted after)",
    y = "Chance the next draft\nbrings the outcome",
    color = NULL,
    caption = "Dashed line: NFL entry (drafted or undrafted). Eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_hazard, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: hazard-pin
stopifnot(
  all(diff(hazard$outcome_nfl_entry_d[1:4]) > 0),
  which.max(hazard$outcome_nfl_entry_d) == 4,
  which.max(hazard$outcome_drafted_d) == 3,
  hz(4, "outcome_signed_udfa_d") > 5 * hz(1, "outcome_signed_udfa_d"),
  hz(3, "outcome_drafted_d") > hz(1, "outcome_drafted_d"),
  max(hazard$eligible_season_index) == 5
)
```

### 3.5 The drafted share of eligible seasons has more than halved across draft classes

```{r}
#| label: trend
#| include: false
trend <- risk |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d),
    entry_ev = sum(outcome_nfl_entry_d),
    drafted = drafted_ev / seasons,
    udfa = mean(outcome_signed_udfa_d),
    entry = entry_ev / seasons,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    entry_lo = wilson(entry_ev, seasons)["lo"],
    entry_hi = wilson(entry_ev, seasons)["hi"]
  ) |>
  ungroup()
tr <- function(y, col) trend[[col]][trend$draft_year == y]
y0 <- min(trend$draft_year)
y1 <- max(trend$draft_year)
```

*Expectation: NFL outcome prevalence is roughly stable across draft
classes.* ❌

Tracking the drafted and entry shares by draft class shows the drafted share
falling from `r pct(tr(y0, "drafted"))` in the `r y0` class to
`r pct(tr(y1, "drafted"))` in `r y1` while the pool of eligible seasons grew
from `r fmt(tr(y0, "seasons"))` to `r fmt(tr(y1, "seasons"))`, and the entry
share jumping with the 2016 class, when the recorded undrafted share nearly
tripled.

```{r}
#| label: trend-fig
#| fig-height: 6
trend_tip <- function(label, col) {
  sprintf(
    "%d, %s: %.1f%% of %s eligible seasons",
    trend$draft_year,
    label,
    100 * trend[[col]],
    fmt(trend$seasons)
  )
}
p_trend <- ggplot(trend, aes(draft_year)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = entry_lo, ymax = entry_hi),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(y = entry), linewidth = 1.4, color = "gray35") +
  geom_line(aes(y = drafted), linewidth = 1.4, color = "#1B9E77") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(y = entry, tooltip = trend_tip("NFL entry", "entry")),
    size = 2.6,
    color = "gray35"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(y = drafted, tooltip = trend_tip("drafted", "drafted")),
    size = 2.6,
    color = "#1B9E77"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2012.1,
    y = 0.127,
    label = "Recorded undrafted signings\njump from the 2016 class on",
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2015.45,
    y = 0.128,
    xend = 2015.85,
    yend = 0.123,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2018.4,
    y = 0.01,
    label = sprintf(
      "Drafted: %.1f%% in %d, %.1f%% in %d",
      100 * tr(y0, "drafted"),
      y0,
      100 * tr(y1, "drafted"),
      y1
    ),
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2022.8,
    y = 0.012,
    xend = 2024,
    yend = 0.0225,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x),
    limits = c(0, 0.14)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(y0, y1, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted share falls steadily while entry swings",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons ending drafted (green) or in NFL entry (gray), by draft class",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Share of eligible seasons",
    caption = "Gray band: 95% confidence interval for NFL entry. Hover a point for the class size."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_trend, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: trend-pin
stopifnot(
  y0 == 2012,
  y1 == 2025,
  tr(y1, "drafted") < tr(y0, "drafted") / 2,
  tr(y0, "seasons") < tr(y1, "seasons") / 4,
  tr(2016, "udfa") > 2.5 * tr(2015, "udfa"),
  tr(2016, "udfa") < 3 * tr(2015, "udfa"),
  tr(2016, "entry") == max(trend$entry[trend$draft_year <= 2016]),
  max(trend$entry_hi) < 0.14
)
```

### 3.6 Nearly half of NFL entrants play no games in their rookie season

```{r}
#| label: entry-year
#| include: false
entrants <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    games = outcome_rookie_games_entry_year,
    bin = cut(
      games,
      breaks = c(-1, 0, 4, 8, 12, 17),
      labels = c(
        "None (Travis, Buechele)",
        "1 to 4 (Allen)",
        "5 to 8",
        "9 to 12 (Burrow)",
        "13 to 17 (Ward)"
      )
    )
  )
games_tab <- entrants |>
  count(bin, name = "n") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), bin = factor(bin, levels = rev(levels(bin))))
made_roster <- mean(entrants$outcome_made_roster_entry_year)
zero_games <- mean(entrants$games == 0)
gm <- function(p) entrants$games[entrants$player == p]
```

*Expectation: most entrants appear on an NFL roster in their entry year.* ✅

Of the `r fmt(nrow(entrants))` entrants, `r pct(made_roster)` appear on an
entry-year NFL roster, yet the regular-season games they played that year,
binned with the running examples placed in their bins, show
`r pct(zero_games)` played none and the median entrant played
`r median(entrants$games)`.

```{r}
#| label: entry-year-fig
#| fig-height: 6
p_games <- ggplot(games_tab, aes(x = 100 * share, y = bin)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s games: %s entrants (%.1f%%)", bin, fmt(n), 100 * share),
      data_id = bin
    ),
    width = 0.7,
    fill = "#1B9E77"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", 100 * share, fmt(n))),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 45,
    y = 3,
    label = "Nearly half of entrants play\nno regular-season game as rookies",
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 56,
    y = 3.3,
    xend = 46,
    yend = 4.62,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 85) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Reaching the NFL and playing in it are different outcomes",
    subtitle = "Share of NFL entrants by regular-season games played in the entry year",
    x = "Share of NFL entrants",
    y = "Rookie games played",
    caption = "Running examples in parentheses: Ward played 17 games, Burrow 10, Allen 2, Travis and Buechele none."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_games, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: entry-year-pin
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(entrants$bin),
  made_roster > 0.95,
  zero_games > 0.45,
  zero_games < 0.5,
  median(entrants$games) == 1,
  # The named examples' facts above must not rot under a refresh.
  gm("Cameron Ward") == 17L,
  gm("Joe Burrow") == 10L,
  gm("Kyle Allen") == 2L,
  all(gm("Jordan Travis") == 0L, gm("Shane Buechele") == 0L)
)
```

## 4. Summary

The base rate a forecasting model has to beat is low and moving. Of
`r fmt(n_risk)` eligible college seasons, `r pct(p_drafted)` end in a draft
selection and `r pct(p_entry)` in NFL entry by either route, and more of
those entrants arrive undrafted (`r pct(udfa_share)`) than drafted. Most
eligible seasons (`r pct(st("continuing"))`) are simply followed by another
college season, so the per-season chance of entry grows as a player waits,
from `r pct(hz(1))` in the first eligible season to `r pct(hz(4))` in the
fourth. Across draft classes the drafted share fell from
`r pct(tr(y0, "drafted"))` (`r y0`) to `r pct(tr(y1, "drafted"))`
(`r y1`). And arriving is not playing: `r pct(zero_games)` of entrants play
no regular-season game as rookies.

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The base rate is not fixed.

- The drafted share fell by more than half across the data's span, so a model
  validated out of time is scored against rarer positives than it trained on.
- Calibration curves and precision at fixed recall say more across years than
  accuracy or raw discrimination figures.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Waiting time carries signal.

- The chance of entry varies about
  `r round(hz(4) / hz(1))`-fold over the eligible seasons, and the
  undrafted chance climbs faster than the drafted chance.
- Modeling drafted status alone discards that structure, and modeling entry
  without routes discards the competition between them.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Entry and playing are different questions.

- Nearly half of entrants play zero rookie games, so the second-stage labels
  (made roster, rookie games) are a separate prediction problem, not a
  footnote on the first.
:::

Several caveats bound these figures.

- The high-school graduation year is imputed for players without a
  recruiting record, `r pct(mean(risk$hs_year_imputed))` of eligible seasons
  including Burrow's and Ward's, and the imputation can mis-time redshirts
  and transfers, shifting rows in and out of the risk set.
- The "left the data early" status is informative censoring that the
  pipeline flags but does not resolve.
- The entry-year roster rate is partly mechanical: the undrafted link is
  defined by roster presence, so an undrafted entrant cannot fail it, and it
  reads better as a check on the link than as a finding.
- Two forces plausibly drive the drafted decline and the 2016 entry jump,
  though neither is tested here: the stat-line population grows faster than
  a draft of fixed size, and NFL roster coverage deepens over the years, so
  the undrafted lookup catches more signings that always happened.

```{r}
#| label: caveat-pin
stopifnot(
  all(risk$hs_year_imputed[risk$player %in% c("Joe Burrow", "Cameron Ward")])
)
```
